## Goal (user story)

As a developer/QA, I want a head-to-head Monte Carlo harness for competitive mode (extending MainStreetMonteCarlo) that runs ≥200 seeds and produces win/score distributions plus per-player metrics, so balance between player and AI can be measured across seeded runs.

## Context

`MainStreetMonteCarlo` is single-player only (`runMonteCarlo` / `runAllCombinations` with one strategy × one difficulty per run). Competitive mode needs head-to-head metrics: both players' win/score distributions plus per-player diagnostics. Architecture is N-player-ready (PlayerRecord[] indexed by owner), but the harness validates the head-to-head (human vs 1 AI) path initially; N>2 extension is a future parameterisation.

## Scope

- Head-to-head harness extending `MainStreetMonteCarlo` (new entry point or flag): both players act per shared-day, same seed → deterministic head-to-head run.
- ≥200 seeds; outputs win/score distributions plus per-player metrics (wins per owner, average score per owner, draw/early-end handling).
- Single-player AI tests (`ai-strategy.test.ts`, balance guardrails) still pass unchanged.

## Out of scope

- AI strategy itself (sibling).
- Per-owner income routing (sibling).
- Rendering / scene (AC5 child).
- Endless continuation (deferred).
- N>2 Monte Carlo — harness is N-player-extensible (numOpponents param) but AC4 validates head-to-head; broader N is a follow-up.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1:** Head-to-head harness runs ≥200 seeds with deterministic head-to-head execution (same seed → same per-owner outcome) and produces win/score distributions (win rate per owner, median/average score per owner).
- [ ] **AC2:** Per-player metrics include at least wins, average score, and loss-reason distribution per owner plus a deterministic summary (draw/early-end handling documented).
- [ ] **AC3:** Extension of `MainStreetMonteCarlo` (not a replacement); existing `runMonteCarlo` / `runAllCombinations` and `monte-carlo-balance.test.ts` still pass.
- [ ] **AC4:** Validated against the adapted competitive AI strategy (CG-0MT5X3N79002S038).

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMonteCarlo.ts` — Competitive head-to-head harness extension (win/score distributions, per-player metrics).
- `tests/main-street/competitive-monte-carlo.test.ts` — Dedicated competitive Monte Carlo tests (determinism, distributions, guardrails).

## Related Work

- Parent: CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30
- Depends on: competitive state model + phase machine + income routing + AI strategy (CG-0MT5X3N79002S038)
- Architecture: N-player-ready state/phase; harness parametrises head-to-head initially

# Intake Brief — Change the name of the Physiotherapy business card to Physiotherapist

**Work item:** CG-0MTRRYOT6001167R
**Issue type:** task · **Priority:** low
**Headline:** The Main Street business card `biz-physio` is displayed as "Physiotherapy" (the treatment) instead of "Physiotherapist" (the practitioner); correct the display name everywhere and drop the now-redundant art alias.

## Problem statement

The Main Street business card with `id=biz-physio` is named **"Physiotherapy"**, which is the treatment rather than the profession/practitioner. Every other business card is named for the business or practitioner, and the card's already-committed art sprite is `Physiotherapist_1024_x_1024.png`. The mismatch is papered over by a spelling alias (`Physiotherapy` → `Physiotherapist`) in the card-art pipeline. The card's display name should be corrected to **"Physiotherapist"** across data, generated assets, tests, and documentation, and the redundant alias removed.

## Users

- **Main Street players** — see the card name on the card face, in the market, in hand, and in tooltips; expect it to read as a business/profession.
- **Developers / content authors** — expect the CSV `name` field to match the committed sprite base name so no alias is required.

### User stories

- As a Main Street player, I see the business card named **"Physiotherapist"** on the card face so the card reads as a profession, consistent with the rest of the business deck.
- As a developer, I can rely on `card-data.csv` `name` matching the sprite base name `Physiotherapist`, so the `Physiotherapy → Physiotherapist` alias is no longer needed.
- As a maintainer, I can regenerate the SVG card faces and the art map from the CSV with no manual name fix-ups.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **CSV data** — The `id=biz-physio` row in `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` has `name=Physiotherapist`; the display string `Physiotherapy` no longer appears in `card-data.csv`.
2. **Generated card face** — `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/biz-physio.svg` regenerated from the CSV contains `aria-label="Physiotherapist"` and card-title text `Physiotherapist`; `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/csv-checksum.json` matches the new CSV checksum.
3. **Art resolution** — `CARD_ART_ALIASES` in `scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` no longer contains a `Physiotherapy` entry, `example-games/main-street/card-art-map.json` is regenerated accordingly, and `resolveCardArtName('Physiotherapist')` / `hasDedicatedCardArt('Physiotherapist')` still resolve to dedicated (non-`Fallback`) art.
4. **References updated** — All display-name references in tests and docs are updated (`tests/main-street/group-a-business-expansion.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/card-art.test.ts`, `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`, `docs/main-street/content-design-and-progression.md`); no `Physiotherapy` remains in source, tests, docs, or generated assets.
5. **Validation** — Unit tests for Main Street pass (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/`) and the production build succeeds (`npm run build`); the full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
6. **Documentation** — All related documentation is updated to reflect the change, including code comments, `README`, and any relevant wiki or docs-site entries (the card catalog and content-design docs above are the primary sites).

## Constraints

- **Do NOT change the card `id`** (`biz-physio`). It is a stable identifier used by saves, tier maps, manifests, and tests; renaming it would break persistence and is out of scope.
- **Do NOT rename sprite files.** `sprites/Physiotherapist_1024_x_1024.png` already uses the target name.
- **Regenerate, do not hand-edit generated artefacts**: `node scripts/generate-main-street-card-svgs.mjs` (card SVGs + `csv-checksum.json`) and `node scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` (`card-art-map.json`, after removing the alias from the script).
- Art must remain resolvable — no regression to the generic `Fallback` sprite.
- Follow the repo doc-update policy for any workflow/tooling implications.

## Existing state

- Committed sprite: `example-games/main-street/sprites/Physiotherapist_1024_x_1024.png` (already target-named).
- Alias introduced by CG-0MTORJ5FS006B0UN: `'Physiotherapy': 'Physiotherapist'` in `scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` (`CARD_ART_ALIASES`), mirrored in generated `example-games/main-street/card-art-map.json` (`aliases`).
- Display-name occurrence sites today:
  - `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` (1 row, `name` field).
  - `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/biz-physio.svg` (aria-label + title text — generated).
  - `example-games/main-street/card-art-map.json` (alias — generated).
  - `tests/main-street/group-a-business-expansion.test.ts` (expected `name`).
  - `tests/main-street/card-art.test.ts` (alias-resolution assertion).
  - `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` (4 references).
  - `docs/main-street/content-design-and-progression.md` (1 reference).
- `docs/main-street/expanded-card-manifest.json` and `card-catalog-baseline.json` reference only the `id`/counts — no change expected.

## Desired change

Rename the `biz-physio` card's display name to **"Physiotherapist"** in the CSV, regenerate the committed SVG card face and `csv-checksum.json`, remove the redundant `Physiotherapy` alias from the art-map generator and regenerate `card-art-map.json`, update the affected tests and docs, and keep card art resolution intact.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — change the `name` field for `biz-physio` to `Physiotherapist`.
- `scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` — remove the `'Physiotherapy': 'Physiotherapist'` alias entry.
- `example-games/main-street/card-art-map.json` — regenerate (alias removed; `Physiotherapist` art key already present).
- `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/biz-physio.svg` — regenerate (title/aria-label).
- `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/csv-checksum.json` — regenerate checksum.
- `tests/main-street/group-a-business-expansion.test.ts` — update expected card `name`.
- `tests/main-street/card-art.test.ts` — update the alias-resolution assertion (assert exact-match resolution for `Physiotherapist`).
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` — update 4 references.
- `docs/main-street/content-design-and-progression.md` — update 1 reference.

## Related work

- **CG-0MTORJ5FS006B0UN** (completed) — Main Street card-art redesign; introduced `CARD_ART_ALIASES` including `Physiotherapy → Physiotherapist`. This item removes that alias by aligning the CSV name.
- **CG-0MUBVL4H80061B1E** (open) — Assign a dedicated sprite to every Main Street card; this rename keeps `biz-physio` on its dedicated sprite.
- **CG-0MTRRYOT6001167R** — this item.

### Related work (automated `find-related` report)

Keyword scan (`business`, `card`, `change`, `name`, `physiotherapist`, `physiotherapy`) returned the following, none of which are direct dependencies of this rename:

- **CG-0MSKU0BE5003I2ZD** (completed) — Main Street combined business/held-event hand; touches business-card UI but not naming.
- **CG-0MQRXN2CT0076OW7** (completed) — Multi-Use Card Economy; touches card economics, not naming.
- **CG-0MQK73QQP005O4OQ** (completed) — Lighting spike; unrelated (keyword noise).
- Repository file matches (`AGENTS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`) are generic keyword hits and require no change.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk:** Changing `card-data.csv` changes `CSV_CHECKSUM`, which flags existing saves as stale. **Mitigation:** regeneration updates `csv-checksum.json`; the existing save-mismatch handling in `MainStreetLifecycleManagerCampaign` already covers this, and card data changes routinely trigger the same path.
- **Risk:** Forgetting to regenerate the committed SVG leaves a stale "Physiotherapy" title on the card face. **Mitigation:** AC2 explicitly checks the generated SVG.
- **Risk:** Removing the alias while the CSV rename is incomplete would drop `biz-physio` to `Fallback` art. **Mitigation:** do the CSV rename and regeneration together; AC3 guards art resolution.
- **Assumption:** Only the display `name` changes — the `id` (`biz-physio`) and sprite filenames stay unchanged.
- **Assumption:** The redundant alias is removed rather than retained (keeping it would leave dead mapping and a stale test).
- **Scope-creep:** Other spelling aliases (`Community Renovation`, `Labor Shortage`, `Neighborhood Watch`, `Graffiti`) are out of scope; record separately if desired.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

No clarifying questions were required — the seed intent ("Change the name of the Physiotherapy business card to Physiotherapist") is unambiguous. The assumptions above (id unchanged, sprite unchanged, alias removed, generated artefacts regenerated) were derived from repository inspection rather than producer input.

- Q: "Should the internal card id `biz-physio` also change?" — Answer (agent, from repo inspection): No. The id is referenced by saves, `CARD_TIER_MAP`, `expanded-card-manifest.json`, `design-12-tiers.py`, and tests; it is a stable identifier. Source: `rg -n "biz-physio"`.
- Q: "Do the sprites need renaming?" — Answer (agent, from repo inspection): No. `sprites/Physiotherapist_1024_x_1024.png` already uses the target name. Source: `ls example-games/main-street/sprites/`.
- Q: "Is the `Physiotherapy` art alias still needed after the rename?" — Answer (agent, from repo inspection): No. Once the CSV name is `Physiotherapist`, it matches the sprite base name exactly, so the alias becomes dead. Source: `scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs:88`.

# Add images for all cards

## Problem Statement

The Main Street card redesign (CG-0MTORJ5FS006B0UN) reserves a 64×64 left-art graphic zone on every card face, but all 162 cards currently display only a placeholder (synergy-coloured rectangle with a single-letter initial). Images must be generated from the `art_notes` descriptions in `card-data.csv`, packaged as PNGs, and embedded into the SVG card rendering pipeline so they appear alongside the card text.

## Users

- **Players**: See distinctive, thematic imagery on every card face in their hand, on the street, and in the market — improving recognisability and atmosphere.
- **Developers**: Have a reproducible image-generation pipeline that produces one PNG per card from `art_notes`, with a safe fallback to a generic placeholder when no image exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Every card across all families (business, community-space, event, upgrade, staff) has an associated 64×64 PNG image file in `public/assets/games/main-street/cards/`.
2. Images are named `<card_id>_64_x_64.png` (e.g. `biz-bakery_64_x_64.png`) and are referenced by the SVG card generator, which attempts to embed the corresponding PNG and falls back to a generic placeholder when the file is missing.
3. The `graphicZoneSvg()` function in `MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` is updated to embed `<image>` elements for the PNG assets (with a fallback `<rect>` + glyph when the image is unavailable or fails to load).
4. All 162 card entries in `card-data.csv` have an `art_notes` value — cards that previously had none receive a generic placeholder description.
5. The full project test suite passes with the changes.

## Risks & Mitigations

- **Image generation quality**: AI-generated images may not match the intended aesthetic. Mitigation: producer reviews images before committing to the repo; a script to regenerate is preferred over manual editing.
- **SVG `<image>` fallback reliability**: SVG `<image>` elements do not gracefully handle missing files — the zone may render blank. Mitigation: the SVG generator emits the `<image>` element, and when the file is absent, falls back to the existing `<rect>` + glyph placeholder.
- **Licensing**: Generated images must be clearly documented as CC0 / self-authored. Mitigation: update `CREDITS.md` with provenance for every new asset directory.
- **Scope creep**: "Every card" could imply artwork for other example games (Golf, Lost Cities, etc.). Mitigation: scope is strictly Main Street 162 cards.

## Constraints

- Images must be permissive / freely available for commercial use (CC0, MIT, or self-authored).
- The naming convention must be deterministic from the card id so the SVG generator can derive asset keys at runtime without additional configuration.
- SVG `<image>` elements must have proper fallback handling so missing assets do not break rendering.
- The 64×64 zone is at `(8, 8)` on the 140×80 card canvas, so images must fit within that rect.

## Existing State

- `public/assets/cards/` — 52 standard playing-card SVGs (CC0, saulspatz/SVGCards) + 1 card back.
- `public/assets/cards/alternative/webisso/` — 52 playing-card SVGs (MIT).
- `public/assets/cards/lost-cities/` — 61 Lost Cities SVGs (MIT).
- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — 162 rows; 157 have `art_notes`, 5 are empty.
- `MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` — `graphicZoneSvg()` produces a coloured rectangle + initial glyph; comment notes: "Future work can replace the `<g>` body with a real `<image>` or family-specific icon."
- No 64×64 card art images exist anywhere in the project.

## Desired Change

1. Populate `art_notes` for the 5 cards that currently have none (use a generic placeholder description).
2. Generate 64×64 PNG images for all 162 cards from their `art_notes` descriptions, naming them `<card_id>_64_x_64.png` (e.g. `biz-bakery_64_x_64.png`, `comm-library_64_x_64.png`).
3. Place images in `public/assets/games/main-street/cards/`.
4. Update `graphicZoneSvg()` to optionally embed an `<image href="...">` element inside the 64×64 zone, with a `<rect>` + glyph fallback.
5. Update the SVG generation pipeline so the asset key is derived from the card id at runtime.

## Key Files (delivered layout, verified 2026-09-29)

- `src/card-data.csv` — card rows; all 173 rows carry an `art_notes` value
- `src/sprites/<Name>_1024_x_1024.png` — producer-supplied source art (1024×1024)
- `src/scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` — builds the art map from the CSV and sprites
- `src/card-art-map.json` — generated card-name → embedded 256×256 WebP `data:` URI map
- `src/MainStreetCardArt.ts` — runtime resolver (`getCardArtDataUri`, `resolveCardArtName`, `hasDedicatedCardArt`)
- `src/scenes/MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` — `graphicZoneSvg()` embeds the clipped `<image>` with a `<rect>` + glyph fallback
- `tests/main-street/card-art.test.ts` — pending-aware drift guard (`PENDING_ART_TARGETS`, baseline 78)
- `public/assets/CREDITS.md` — artifact provenance to update when the new sprites land

## Related Work

- **CG-0MTORJ5FS006B0UN** — Redesign all Main Street cards with 64×64 left-art (created the placeholder zone).
- **CG-0MMJTGQFE1RL6VJA** — Add synergy icons to Main Street help panel (complementary asset work).
- **CG-0MM4RF91E1LR5RSY** — Main Street: PRD Milestone 4 — Visual Polish, Animation, and Audio (mentions placeholder-to-final art pipeline).

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- Q: Image format? — **Answer (producer):** PNG files.
- Q: How will images be created and named? — **Answer (producer):** Producer will provide images; naming convention `<card_name>_64_x_64.png`, derived from card id. Placeholder used if image not found.
- Q: Scope — all card families? — **Answer (producer):** Every family (business, community-space, event, upgrade, staff).
- Q: Placement approach — SVG or external Phaser assets? — **Answer (producer):** Embedded in SVG.
- Q: Cards without art_notes (5 cards)? — **Answer (producer):** Create art_notes; use a placeholder description.
## Related work (automated report)

- **CG-0MQ7G3DTJ0082CGR** – Sushi Go: Partial HandView migration (layout only) (completed)
- **CG-0MM4RDYAU1DY4OG8** – Main Street: PRD Milestone 1 -- Playable Core Loop (Walking Skeleton) (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: absent, accept, acceptance, add, additional (+194 more)

# Add a Charity Shop business card (MS-0MUAYBAHW007RMSL) — Intake brief

## Problem statement

Main Street has no charity shop: a low-cost, Culture-synergy business that trades a modest income for a steady reputation trickle. The producer has specified the card's core economy (1.5 income/turn, 0.15 reputation/turn, cost 3 at the pre-scale convention), and this work adds the card to the pool so players gain an early reputation-leaning Culture business at tier 2.

## Users (example user stories)

- **As a player**, I can buy a Charity Shop for 300 coins and place it on the street, where it produces a small income and a steady reputation gain each turn, giving me an early Culture-synergy building with a reputation focus.
- **As a player**, I expect the Charity Shop to participate in Culture adjacency synergy like other Culture businesses (Bookshop, Craft Shop), so I can cluster it with my Culture cards.
- **As a maintainer**, I expect the new card to be a first-class registered template — present in the CSV, the tier/progression system, generated metadata and card art — with all template-count and consistency tests updated rather than special-cased.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Card data.** `src/card-data.csv` contains a new business row with exactly: `family = business`, `id = biz-charity-shop`, `name = Charity Shop`, `cost = 300`, `baseIncome = 150`, `synergyTypes = Culture`, `upgradePath = Charity Shop`, `maxLevel = 1`, `reputationPerTurn = 15`, `ongoingCost = 75`, `tier = 2`, plus a non-empty `description` and `art_notes`.
2. **Registered template.** The card is loaded by `MainStreetCards.ts` as a business template, is available at tier 2 through the tier/`CARD_TIER_MAP` progression, and appears in the business deck built by `createBusinessDeck()`.
3. **Generated metadata and art.** `docs/main-street/expanded-card-manifest.json` lists `biz-charity-shop` under `expandedCardIds.business`, and `node src/scripts/generate-main-street-card-svgs.mjs` produces `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/biz-charity-shop.svg`; both are committed.
4. **Tests.** Automated tests assert the Charity Shop's `cost`, `baseIncome`, `reputationPerTurn`, `ongoingCost`, `synergyTypes` and `tier`, and every hardcoded count affected by adding one business template is updated:
   - business-template count `30 → 31` in `game-state.test.ts` (`BUSINESS_TEMPLATE_COUNT`), `expanded-card-pool.test.ts`, `group-a-business-expansion.test.ts` (test title/comment too), and the `createBusinessDeck(1).length` assertions in the `group-b`…`group-f` expansion tests;
   - aggregate pool totals in `meta-progression.test.ts`: tier-12 `cumulativeCardIds` `173 → 174` and unique base-id `allBaseIds.size` `165 → 166`;
   - the hardcoded tier-2 synergy snapshot in `tier-synergy-balance.test.ts` becomes `{ Commerce: 2, Service: 1, Culture: 1 }`.
   The full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
5. **Documentation.** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` (business table, deck-size/expansion counts, synergy-type coverage) and any relevant README or docs-site entries. **Note:** `CHANGELOG.md` is excluded — managed by the ship skill's release pipeline.

## Constraints

- **×100 integer economy** (CG-0MTIO1M15001E9Y6): all coin/reputation CSV values are integers at 100× the design scale — `cost 300`, `baseIncome 150`, `reputationPerTurn 15`. No fractional values anywhere in the CSV.
- **Ongoing cost convention** (CG-0MSVYPEZ90085SHE): businesses pay ¼ of purchase price per turn (min 25), so `ongoingCost = 75`; the card is charged this while in hand or on the street.
- **Card text must match data** (`card-text-data-consistency` test): the `description` reputation figure must equal the `reputationPerTurn` value and the synergy sentence must match the Culture synergy.
- **Tier-2 synergy balance** (`tier-synergy-balance.test.ts`, ≤2× ratio): tier 2 becomes Commerce 2 / Service 1 / Culture 1 — ratio 2.0, which passes.
- **Tier family balance** (`tier-family-balance.test.ts`, ≤46% per family): tier 2 business share becomes 4/22 ≈ 18.2% — passes.
- **Producer-specified cost override:** the balance curve (`tier*2 + 2 + baseIncome*4 + …`) would price this card higher than 300; the producer's explicit `cost 3` (300) takes precedence and is recorded as a deliberate manual override, not a curve result.

## Existing state

- There is **no** charity shop / thrift / op-shop card in `card-data.csv` or `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`; this is a net-new template.
- The pool currently has **30 business templates**; tier 2 contains Hardware Store (Service), Pawn Shop (Commerce) and Boutique (Commerce).
- Business cards are generic CSV-driven templates; `MainStreetCards.ts` parses rows, and per-tier registration is derived from the CSV `tier` column (`CARD_TIER_MAP`) — no bespoke TypeScript class is needed.
- Tests hardcode both the business-template count (`30`) **and aggregate pool totals** (tier-12 cumulative `173`, unique base-id set `165`), and `docs/main-street/expanded-card-manifest.json` enumerates every non-baseline business id (currently 26 business ids; with the 4 tier-1 baseline business ids the total is 30) — all must be updated. `tier-synergy-balance.test.ts` also hardcodes the per-tier synergy snapshot.
- Business card art resolves through `card-art-map.json` with a generic `Fallback` sprite when a dedicated 1024×1024 sprite is absent.

## Desired change

Add the Charity Shop as a tier-2 Culture business template with the values in AC1, regenerate the derived metadata and SVG card artifacts, update the hardcoded business-count assertions and the catalog documentation, and add/extend tests asserting the new card's economy.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/card-data.csv` — add the `biz-charity-shop` business row.
- `docs/main-street/expanded-card-manifest.json` — regenerate via `npx vite-node src/scripts/generate-main-street-expanded-card-manifest.ts` (business id list grows 26 → 27).
- `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/biz-charity-shop.svg` — generated by `node src/scripts/generate-main-street-card-svgs.mjs`.
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` — add the card to the tier-2 business table; update the two deck-size tables (Business 30 → 31, business cards 90 → 93), the expansion summary (Business 30 → 31, total 157 → 158, net +142 → +143) and the synergy-type coverage table (Culture single 4 → 5; Culture total 10 → 11).
- `tests/main-street/game-state.test.ts` — `BUSINESS_TEMPLATE_COUNT` 30 → 31.
- `tests/main-street/group-a-business-expansion.test.ts` — business template count 30 → 31 (and wording/comment).
- `tests/main-street/expanded-card-pool.test.ts` — business template count 30 → 31 (and test description).
- `tests/main-street/group-b-community-space-expansion.test.ts`, `group-c-investment-events-expansion.test.ts`, `group-d-incident-events-expansion.test.ts`, `group-e-upgrade-cards-expansion.test.ts`, `group-f-staff-abilities-expansion.test.ts` — `createBusinessDeck(1).length` 30 → 31.
- `tests/main-street/meta-progression.test.ts` — tier-12 `cumulativeCardIds` 173 → 174 (test title/comment too) and `allBaseIds.size` 165 → 166.
- `tests/main-street/tier-synergy-balance.test.ts` — extend the hardcoded sparse-tier snapshot for `'tier-2'` with `Culture: 1` (and update the header comment); optionally add a Charity Shop synergy assertion.
- `tests/main-street/card-manifest.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/card-svg-coverage.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/tier-family-balance.test.ts` — driven by the regenerated artifacts/CSV; verify they pass.
- `tests/main-street/card-text-data-consistency.test.ts` — verifies card text matches data; passes once `description`/`art_notes` match the values in AC1.
- `docs/main-street/balancing-methodology.md` — add a Special Cases note for the producer's manual cost override (if the balance doc is maintained against the CSV).

## Related work

> The `CG-` ids below are from the legacy Tableau-Card-Engine (core) worklog; the same content was migrated to this repo under the `MS-` prefix (see the migration comment on this item).

- `CG-0MUAYBA0L000XLK3` — Pawn shop should reduce, not increase reputation (sibling migrated producer note; establishes the ×100 value convention for business cards).
- `CG-0MTIO1M15001E9Y6` — integer economy (coin/rep ×100).
- `CG-0MSVYPEZ90085SHE` — business ongoing cost (¼ purchase price, min 25).
- `CG-0MUIH30NQ0047W1I` — Reconcile event card text to integer data; `CG-0MTW1EN0D003CSA0` — validate all card text.
- `CG-0MT3IPFSF005KEFB` — tier synergy-type balance rule (constrains tier-2 placement).
- `CG-0MT3C744B009DS84` / `CG-0MT2WU0CX005Z143` — 12-tier progression and family rebalance.
- Automated related-work report: `CG-0MSQE2NLX003ADIY` (Main Street: design 50+ new cards), `CG-0MMJTGQFE1RL6VJA` (synergy icons in help panel).

## Risks and assumptions

- **Assumption (producer-confirmed, Q2):** synergy type is **Culture** (a charity shop might thematically read as Commerce; overridden by the producer's answer).
- **Assumption (producer-confirmed, Q3):** **tier 2, standalone** (`maxLevel = 1`, no upgrade chain).
- **Assumption (producer-confirmed, Q1):** 1.5 is **gross** `baseIncome`; the standard 75 ongoing cost applies on top (net 0.75/turn).
- **Assumption (not explicitly confirmed; low risk):** `id = biz-charity-shop`, `name = Charity Shop`, and house-style `description`/`art_notes` text; the card uses the generic fallback sprite until dedicated art is supplied.
- **Risk:** hardcoded business counts **and aggregate pool totals** are spread across many tests; missing one turns the suite red — the count updates are the largest part of the change.
- **Risk:** regenerating `expanded-card-manifest.json` and SVG artifacts produces large/generated diffs; regenerate via the documented scripts rather than hand-editing.
- **Scope-creep guard:** dedicated 1024×1024 artwork for the card is **out of scope**; if wanted, record it as a linked follow-up work item rather than expanding this one.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions and answers

- **Q1: Are the stated numbers gross or net of the standard ongoing cost?**
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply during the originating intake session): A** — 1.5 is gross `baseIncome`; `baseIncome = 150`, `ongoingCost = 75`, net 0.75/turn. Questions recorded in comment `MS-C0MUIM7ZSS0001IW4` on this item.
- **Q2: Which synergy type should the Charity Shop belong to?**
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply during the originating intake session): C** — `Culture`. Questions recorded in comment `MS-C0MUIM7ZSS0001IW4`.
- **Q3: Which progression tier, and should it have an upgrade path?**
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply during the originating intake session): A** — `tier = 2`, standalone (`upgradePath = Charity Shop`, `maxLevel = 1`). Questions recorded in comment `MS-C0MUIM7ZSS0001IW4`.
- **Note:** these answers were carried over from the originating (core-repo) intake; the producer should confirm them alongside the corrected paths/counts at the next review.
- **Non-blocking assumptions:** `id`/`name`/`description`/`art_notes` and fallback-art usage were proposed in the questions comment and **not corrected** by the producer; they are treated as accepted defaults unless the producer objects.

# Intake Brief — Move level label to left (MS-0MUGRKEWZ0073327)

## Problem Statement
When a business or community-space card is upgraded it shows a gold level badge
("Lvl 1", "Lvl 2", …) in the **top-right** corner of the card face. This
position competes with the cost circle / right-hand text column and reads as a
secondary stat rather than the card's primary upgrade indicator. The badge
should move to the **top-left** of the card so the upgrade level is immediately
visible in a consistent, expected position.

## Users
- **Main Street player** — wants to identify an upgraded card's level at a
  glance when scanning the street grid and their hand.
- **Future example-game authors / designers** — reuse the shared
  `UpgradeOverlaySpec` contract and expect a single, predictable corner
  convention for the level badge.

### User Stories
- As a player, when I look at an upgraded card on the street or in my hand, I
  see the "Lvl N" badge at the top-left of the card, so the level is obvious at
  a glance.
- As a player, the badge position is identical whether the card is shown on the
  street grid or in the hand, so I never have to re-learn where to look.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For every upgraded card (`level > 0`), the level badge is positioned at
      the card's **top-left**: in container-local coordinates (origin at the
      card centre) `levelBadge.x` is negative (left of centre) and the badge is
      **left-anchored** (`originX === 0`); the badge is no longer placed in the
      top-right (`x` must not be positive in the mirrored position). Verified by
      unit test on `buildUpgradeOverlaySpec` for level 1 and level 2 cards.
- [ ] The Phaser renderer (`applyUpgradeOverlays`) renders the badge with a
      left/top origin so the text starts at the top-left inset and remains fully
      inside the card bounds (no clipping past the left or top edge); the same
      overlay path is used by street and hand cards, so both move together.
      Verified by renderer/overlay tests.
- [ ] Badge content and styling are unchanged (`Lvl N`, gold `#ffdd44`, bold,
      10px) and no badge is produced for level 0 (base) cards.
- [ ] The dynamic SVG card-face generator (`generateBusinessCardSvg`) emits the
      level badge at the top-left (`x` at the card's left inset,
      `text-anchor="start"`) for consistency with the overlay, with its unit
      tests updated accordingly.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries
      (notably the module docs in `UpgradeOverlaySpec.ts` /
      `MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` and the level-badge references in
      `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md`).
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes, with all existing
      top-right level-badge expectations updated to the top-left contract.

## Constraints
- Card geometry is fixed: canonical **140 × 80** card with a **64 × 64 art zone
  at (8, 8)** (top-left) — see `docs/main-street/card-dimensions.md`. The
  top-left corner is therefore occupied by the card art; the badge will render
  over the top-left of the art zone (mirroring the current badge overlaying the
  top-right). This is an accepted input to the brief (see Risks & Assumptions).
- Presentation-only change — no change to upgrade rules, card state, or level
  numbers.
- Reuse the existing overlay/badge primitives and gold styling; do not introduce
  new assets or a second badge component.
- Keep the overlay spec a pure data module (no Phaser imports) so it stays
  unit-testable in Node.

## Existing State
- `src/scenes/UpgradeOverlaySpec.ts` builds the badge at
  `x = Math.round(width / 2 - 4)`, `y = Math.round(4 - height / 2)` (top-right,
  4 px inset) with `color: '#ffdd44'`, `fontSize: '10px'`, `fontStyle: 'bold'`.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererStreet.ts` (`applyUpgradeOverlays`) creates the
  Phaser Text and calls `lvlText.setOrigin(1, 0)` — right/top anchored — so the
  badge sits in the top-right.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` (`generateBusinessCardSvg`) emits
  `<text x="${width - 8}" y="13" … text-anchor="end">Lvl N</text>` (top-right)
  for upgraded cards. (This dynamic SVG path is exercised by unit tests; the
  runtime card face texture comes from the CSV-based template SVGs.)
- Tests asserting/pinning the badge: `tests/main-street/upgraded-card-rendering.test.ts`
  (positions the badge in the top-right), `tests/main-street/upgrade-overlay-spec.test.ts`
  and `tests/main-street/cash-line-overlay.test.ts` (badge presence/text),
  `tests/main-street/card-svg-generator.test.ts` (badge text).

## Desired Change
- Mirror the badge to the top-left: overlay `x = Math.round(-width / 2 + 4)`
  with `originX: 0` (and `setOrigin(0, 0)` in the renderer); `y` stays at the
  existing top inset so the badge remains on the top edge.
- Update the SVG generator badge to `x = 8` (or the chosen left inset) with
  `text-anchor="start"`.
- Update the module/JSDoc comments and the affected tests from "top-right" to
  "top-left". Exact inset values may be tuned during implementation as long as
  the badge is left-anchored in the top-left and stays inside the card bounds.

## Key Files
- `src/scenes/UpgradeOverlaySpec.ts` — level-badge spec `x` / `originX` and the
  "top-right corner" comment; primary change.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererStreet.ts` — `applyUpgradeOverlays` badge
  `setOrigin(1, 0)` → `(0, 0)`; comment.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` — dynamic SVG badge position /
  `text-anchor`; module doc mentions "level badge top-right".
- `tests/main-street/upgraded-card-rendering.test.ts` — update the top-right
  position assertion to top-left and assert left-anchoring.
- `tests/main-street/upgrade-overlay-spec.test.ts` — badge position/style
  expectations.
- `tests/main-street/cash-line-overlay.test.ts` — badge presence/absence
  alongside the cash line (position regression surface).
- `tests/main-street/card-svg-generator.test.ts` — SVG badge text/position.
- `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` — level-badge placement references.

## Related Work
- **Potentially related docs:**
  - `docs/main-street/card-dimensions.md` — canonical 140×80 card and the
    `(8, 8)` 64×64 art zone that occupies the top-left.
  - `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` — upgrade level-up burst notes that
    reference the newly-rendered level badge.
  - `src/scenes/UpgradeOverlaySpec.ts` header — documents the overlay contract
    and the card-local coordinate system.
- **Potentially related work items:**
  - `MS-0MTV69NII000LW8I` — *Position end-turn coin matrix on left side of card,
    growing right* (bug, medium) — closest precedent: a card-face overlay
    repositioned from centre/right to left, landed with documented placement
    assumptions.
  - `MS-0MU9JYNZ3008AH5J` — *Update createCoinGrid defaults to left-anchored
    position* (task) — companion implementation task for the sister reposition.
  - `MS-0MUBVL4H80061B1E` — *Assign a dedicated 64×64 sprite to every Main
    Street card* (medium) — touches the top-left art zone that the badge will
    now overlay.
  - `MS-0MTRRYOT6001167R` — *Change the name of Physiotherapy business card to
    Physiotherapist* (task, low) — another card-face presentation tweak with
    test/doc churn.
  - Historical (core-repo) references cited in code: `CG-0MTORJ5FS006B0UN`
    (64×64 left-art layout) and `CG-0MP1VJVEK003I7VE` (display upgrade state on
    street-grid cards) — the layout and overlay these tests assert were
    introduced/refined there.
- **Automated report** (generated by `find-related`) — see the
  "Related work (automated report)" section retained below.

## Risks & Assumptions
- **Assumption:** "top left" means the card's top-left corner, mirroring the
  current right-side inset, with the badge left-aligned. Because the 64×64 art
  zone occupies `(8, 8)`–`(72, 72)`, the badge will overlay the top-left of the
  card art. That is accepted; if the producer finds it illegible over the art, a
  subtle backing chip or a slightly different inset is a small follow-up — it
  must be raised rather than assumed.
- **Visual-regression risk:** the badge colour (`#ffdd44` gold) may have low
  contrast against some card art; mitigate during implementation by checking the
  darkest/lightest card arts and, if needed, a 1 px dark outline (recorded as a
  follow-up if it expands scope).
- **Test churn:** `upgraded-card-rendering.test.ts` explicitly asserts a
  top-right position; update the assertions to the top-left contract in the same
  change rather than deleting them.
- **Scope creep:** do not restyle the badge, redesign the 64×64 layout, or
  change the cost circle / title / cash line. Record any broader card-face polish
  as separate work items.

## Open Questions
- None — the seed context (position the upgrade level badge at the top-left
  instead of the top-right) plus repo inspection of the overlay/spec/renderer
  provided sufficient signal for a clear brief. The only judgement call (badge
  overlays the top-left art zone) is recorded above as an assumption to be
  confirmed during review; no clarifying interview was required.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers
- No interview conducted — the work-item description ("When a card is upgraded

# Add per-turn running costs to Playground, Town Fountain and Community Shelter

## Summary

Give the three remaining free-to-run Main Street community-space cards a per-turn running cost, following the Park precedent (CG-0MU9NW9EP003B1AK) and the producer decision of 2026-09-29. Today the Playground (`cs-playground`), Town Fountain (`cs-fountain`) and Community Shelter (`cs-shelter`) have `ongoingCost` empty → 0, so they are free synergy/reputation anchors.

## Problem statement

The Park was given a 40 coins/turn running cost to stop costless synergy spam. Three other community spaces still have no ongoing cost, so the same "free anchor" dynamic remains for their synergies:

- **Playground** (`cs-playground`) — cost 400, Entertainment, +5 rep/turn, ongoing 0.
- **Town Fountain** (`cs-fountain`) — cost 500, Culture, +10 rep/turn, ongoing 0.
- **Community Shelter** (`cs-shelter`) — cost 600, Service, +15 rep/turn, ongoing 0 (retiered T6→T3, CG-0MT5VZJLS000B8KI).

## Users

- **Player** — building a Playground/Fountain/Shelter cluster should feel the per-turn drain as a real strategic cost.
- **Producer / balance owner** — wants a running-cost lever on every community space, not just Park/Library/Garden/Kiosk/Public Art.

## Acceptance criteria

1. **Card data** — `cs-playground`, `cs-fountain` and `cs-shelter` in the Main Street `card-data.csv` each have a non-zero integer `ongoingCost`, confirmed with the producer before merge. **Proposed mapping (agent suggestion, producer-owned — confirm or override): Playground 20, Town Fountain 25, Community Shelter 30.**
2. **Descriptions** — each updated `card-data.csv` description states the running cost using the existing wording ("Costs N coins per turn to run."), consistent with Library/Community Garden/Park, and the `card-text-data-consistency` test passes.
3. **Deduction** — at end of turn each placed, unsold card deducts its `ongoingCost` through the existing `applyCommunitySpaceOngoingCosts()` path, clamped at 0 coins and logged with an insufficient-funds log when applicable.
4. **Tooltips** — each card's community-space tooltip shows `Ongoing cost: -N/turn`; each card's cash line shows `-N`.
5. **Sold-card exemption preserved** — a sold Playground/Fountain/Shelter incurs no ongoing cost (CG-0MU3VH7QW006A2XA).
6. **Tests** — add distinct coverage for each card's deduction, clamping and sold-exemption (no redundant duplicates); update any test that assumes these cards are free to run (e.g. `tests/main-street/group-b-community-space-expansion.test.ts` "does not deduct for zero-ongoing-cost cards" currently uses Playground + Fountain + Shelter and must be re-pointed at cards that remain free, or reworked).
7. **Balance sanity** — Monte Carlo and tutorial guardrails remain green; any drift is measured and reported, and no guardrail band is silently widened. Note the tutorial scenario places no Playground/Fountain/Shelter (verify).
8. **Docs** — update `docs/main-street/content-design-and-progression.md` (Ongoing/turn column), `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`, `docs/main-street/balancing-methodology.md` (special-cases) and any other doc listing these cards' running costs.
9. **Full project test suite passes.**

## Constraints

- **Integer economy (hard):** coins are whole integers (CG-0MTIO1M15001E9Y6); no fractional `ongoingCost`.
- **Data is source of truth:** the running cost lives in `card-data.csv`; tooltip, overlay and deduction derive from it.
- **Charging semantics unchanged:** placed, unsold cards only; clamped at 0; reuse the existing community-space mechanism.
- **Balance values are producer-owned:** the proposed mapping is an agent suggestion; the producer confirms or overrides before merge.

## Existing state

- `cs-playground`: cost 400, baseIncome 0, Entertainment, rep 5, `ongoingCost` empty.
- `cs-fountain`: cost 500, baseIncome 0, Culture, rep 10, `ongoingCost` empty.
- `cs-shelter`: cost 600, baseIncome 0, Service, rep 15, `ongoingCost` empty.
- Park precedent: `docs/main-street/...`; commit `5ffd54a` in `tce-main-street` set `cs-park` to 40/turn and updated tests/tooltip/cash-line/docs.
- Test that assumes they are free: `tests/main-street/group-b-community-space-expansion.test.ts` "does not deduct for zero-ongoing-cost cards".

## Key files (predicted)

- `src/card-data.csv` (tce-main-street repo) — set the three `ongoingCost` values and descriptions.
- `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/csv-checksum.json` — regenerated by the suite; no SVG face change expected (community-space ongoing cost is not baked in).
- `tests/main-street/community-space-ongoing-cost.test.ts` — add per-card deduction/clamp/sold coverage.
- `tests/main-street/community-space-tooltip.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/ongoing-cost-tooltips.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/cash-line-overlay.test.ts` — tooltip/cash-line coverage.
- `tests/main-street/group-b-community-space-expansion.test.ts` — rework the zero-cost test.
- `docs/main-street/content-design-and-progression.md`, `card-catalog.md`, `balancing-methodology.md`.

## Related work

## Risks & assumptions

- **Value assumption:** the three proposed values (20/25/30) are an agent suggestion; the producer must confirm or override before merge.

- Optional `storylineId` + `storylineTitle` on `EventCard` (and the CSV), parsed by `src/MainStreetCardsTemplates.ts`; absent fields preserve today's behaviour.
